title: All reviewed bid sheets
question: For which projects can the City and State records be matched?
finding: Reviewed all 108 source sheets. 107 have a matched City contract, 83 list at least one City subcontractor, and 103 have a corroborating state project registration.
how: Checked agency, solicitation or contract number, scope, timing and named awardee. The November 8 City register is supplemented by the November 22 returns for the two SOMArts-labelled numbers. The review retains ambiguous and rejected state identifiers.
limits: The extract covers three agencies and selected years. A missing roster may reflect a reporting limit, self-performance or an agency record held separately. Around similarly named projects the signed scope and team take precedence.
